test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

UHS, OJQ, ILO, ENM, ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **First alphabets in each cluster are vowels in backwards order, U-O-I-E-A.**

 **Second alphabet is increased to 2 positional values.

 **Third alphabet is decreased to 2 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da7f18ccfc7d48e4673baf54a467e46ee3f29f1437d1d66ef9551d5dc1f960cb.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
